keyFindings.description: Lines 100-103: dispatchDefaultTierRollingReplicas assumes a roll runs replicas+1 pods. A Deployment does not count terminating pods (Kubernetes Deployment docs; KEP-3973, podReplacementPolicy alpha), and a terminating server pod keeps its pools until shutdown.go:107 closes them, inside the 35 s grace, while the next surge pod can be ready in about 10 s. At the stated 4 replicas, 6 x 83 = 498 exceeds the 497 Dispatch may use, so the bound, the test pinning 4, README.md:200-203, CHANGELOG.md:938-941 and the PR body all overstate the tier. Count the terminating overlap and state it, or state the assumption and its risk.

Lines 202-203 (and dispatch.go:98) say a test fails 'when a pool changes'. It fails only when a counted pool's size changes; a new pool or a fourth Pool.Listener caller passes unseen. Narrow the wording.
